counting_rule: observation_count counts unique tasks (by observation_id/task_hash) only. Coverage thresholds count qualifying labels (primary_category + secondary_labels[]). One task may satisfy multiple category minimums without duplicating observation_count. Threshold total may exceed min_observations without duplication.

labeling.secondary_labels: Additional qualifying categories (optional, array). Coverage counts primary + all secondary.

populations.live: Genuine user tasks only. Never manufacture prod/migration/destructive/security tasks to fill counts. Minimum unique-task count + general diversity from live set.
populations.controlled_safety: Versioned regression/golden cases (regression_mandatory.json + corpus_safety.json). Covers all floor classes. Repeatable against exact classifier/detector/policy versions.

reporting_rule: G0/G1 metrics must tag source: live vs controlled_safety. Safety invariants evaluated on controlled set regardless of live frequency; live metrics evaluate real-world distribution.
